name: CiApmTrace
description: Sends CI pipeline traces to Elastic APM
author: kester.simm.mockholm@outlook.com
helpMarkDown: Sends CI pipeline traces to Elastic APM. Requires an Elastic APM service connection. The PreJob handler opens a job span, the main step records a custom span, and the PostJob handler ends the span, sends the trace, and records errors and metrics when the job fails.

inputs.name: apmConnection
inputs.label: Elastic APM connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: The Elastic APM service connection to use. Create one under Project settings > Pipelines > Service connections using the 'Elastic APM' type.

inputs.name: fail
inputs.label: Force pipeline failure
inputs.helpMarkDown: Force the trace to end as a failure

inputs.name: debug
inputs.label: Debug output
inputs.helpMarkDown: Show the APM server response body in the build log
